name: reschedule_appointment
description: Call this to move an existing booking with Kornél to a new time — for a booking made earlier in THIS call or a previous call. Looks up their soonest upcoming booking by phone number and moves it. Always call check_availability first to get a real new slot before calling this.

phone.description: The real caller's phone number in E.164 format — must be either the resolved caller_number value or a number the caller stated and you confirmed digit-by-digit. Never a placeholder or invented number. This is how their existing booking gets found, so it must be accurate.

start_iso.description: The exact start_iso value from the new slot the caller chose in check_availability's response

end_iso.description: The exact end_iso value from the new slot the caller chose in check_availability's response

timezone.description: The caller's IANA timezone, e.g. America/New_York, America/Chicago, America/Denver, America/Los_Angeles
